name: move-message
description: Moves an Outlook email (message) to another mail folder, or archives it, the default destination. The message id comes from microsoft-outlook__search-messages and a folder id from microsoft-outlook__list-mail-folders. The moved message has a new id.

destinationId.description: Folder ID from microsoft-outlook__list-mail-folders, or a well-known folder name such as archive, inbox, deleteditems, junkemail, drafts, or sentitems. Defaults to archive.
